# Words to flag as errors for subodhdahal.github.io
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# One entry per line, matched against a full token. Entries are added
# to the built-in Vale.Avoid rule, which reports every occurrence as an
# error (message: "Avoid '...'").
#
# Note: entries from accept.txt also suppress this rule, so don't list
# the same word in both files. Typos like "beacuse" are already caught
# by Vale.Spelling, which gives a better "did you mean ...?" message.
#
# Lines starting with `#` are comments.
#
# Source: forked from the draft-text skill's vocabulary
# (../agent-skills/.agents/skills/productivity/draft-text/vale/styles/config/vocabularies/Draft/reject.txt).
# Phrase-level AI tells (negative parallelism, "in order to", dead
# transitions, hype compounds) are handled by the bundled Draft style
# and the ai-tells package, not this list.
#
# Entries are case-sensitive regexes by default, so each word carries a
# `(?i)` prefix to catch every casing. Add inflections as separate
# entries because Vale matches whole tokens: `delve` will not also
# catch `delving`.
#
# To tune the list, delete lines or comment them out with `#`.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
